nom: Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil Face Cleanser for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: Love cleansing oils when i wear makeup and Bioderma, but ugh, this is the worst! It's heavy, sticky and slimy. Very difficult to wash off.

I was honestly surprised by how lightweight this cleansing oil feels. It melts away sunscreen and long-wear makeup without any harsh rubbing, then rinses off clean without leaving a greasy film. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and calm after every use. It's such a relaxing first cleanse, and I'll definitely keep reaching for it every day.

There is something strange about this oil. Its very light in texture and appkies beautifully but when you add water is where it goes downhill. It doesnt emulsify and it hard to remove. I find that i had to use a cloth because water and my hands werent enough.
If you have sensative akin stay FAR away. The texture even after doing a doible cleanse does not leave your skin. You wake up feeling GREASY! With little red angery ance friends. No thanks

This product leaves my skin feeling very slimy and not clean at all. I usually use DHC which has been a great cleansing oil, and decided to swap it up since this was about half of the price. I definitely did get what I paid for and likely won't use the rest of the product.
I not only use this to remove makeup, but also as a base for dermaplaning my face at home.
This lasted me 5 to 6 months. It takes off makeup well if you apply it to dry skin. Sometimes I'll use it to help take off sunscreen. I would buy again.

I really wanted to love this cleansing oil because it is marketed for sensitive skin, but it immediately broke me out in areas that I haven't had acne in years. Unfortunately, the very first ingredient is comedogenic, which is surprising for a product aimed at people who are already dealing with reactive or acne prone skin. If you are acne prone or cautious about pore clogging ingredients, definitely check the ingredient list before purchasing.
Once you add water, it becomes a hard to remove layer. Definitely have to fouble cleanse.

there's better oil cleansers out there, this one takes forever to emulsify with water to remove makeup, doesnt remove waterproof eyeliner / mascara very well. over all, its messy and i hate the residue. will not repurchase

i bought this because my other oil cleanser ran out and they dont carry it in store anymore.. well this producy is NOT IT. it literally just caked up the makeup on my face in clumps and then smeared on my face when i fried fo rub it off. even when i got it milky with water it didnt do anything. go buy something else

I have used this to bottle to empty which took wbout 3 months. It doesn't remove makeup well at all. It seems to smear the foundation around on my face rather than remove it. Eye makeup comes off a little bit, but not much at all. I was very disappointed with this. I used the blue bottle from this brand and it was much better.

This product did not work as advertised. It just sort of smeared my makeup all over my face, which was surprising to me since I only wear a very light coverage type of makeup. I feel like using just plain water would have been more effective. Will be returning.

love this makeup oil cleanser! doesnt burn the eyes, takes off MOST makeup & makes my skin feel soft. the only thing is you definitely have to double cleanse as it doesnt take everything everything off

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: This is the best cleansing oil I've ever tried, seriously. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin and removes my makeup so easily. I absolutely love it

If you're like me, and are extremely particular about complete makeup removal, YOU NEED THIS. Just a few drops of oil go a LONG way, removing every drop of makeup seamlessly. Waterproof mascara? No problem. Full coverage foundation? Easy. My face has never felt cleaner after wearing a full face all day.
removes eye makeup and doesnt irriate my eyes or skin or break me out

I switched to this from Palmer's thinking it wouod be better for my skin since its unscented. Boy, was i wrong! After a couple of weeks I started to get the worst breakouts I've ever had in my life. After some process of elimination and research, turns out the first two ingredients have a moderate-to-high risk of being comedogenic (pore-clogging). So dont believe everything you see on the packagaing! I'm sure it's fine for some people, but definitely not suitable for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Not the best not the worst
avis.texte: Overall this product was pretty good, but I didn't get anything special out of it! If anything it irritated my skin, but I also have very sensitive skin. It does do what described though.

Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil Face Cleanser Is wonderful at removing makeup and sunscreen. I used this cleanser at the beach after multiple applications of caked on sun screen and makeup and it removed both easily. It leaves my face feeling clean, moisturized, and nourished like baby soft skin! Love this!

I use waterproof eyeliner and this oil cleanses every bit of it off my face. I do have very sensitive skin but this didn't bother it at all! You do need to rinse this oil off after but it's super effective. It also removes sticky/tacky sunscreen which is usually hard to get off! I will be purchasing this product instead of the one I've used for years, I prefer this!!
I love this product. It dissolved the makeup quickly. The only con was I had to wash my face twice to get the oily feeling off.
Usually products like this burn my eyes and don't remove all makeup. This oil removed 90% of my makeup, including mascara, and didn't burn my eyes.

I really wanted to love this product, but it just doesn't do enough for me. I really don't think this should be labeled a cleansing oil because it does not do any cleansing. It's an OK make up remover but compared to other cleansing oils it's not cleansing at all.

I was hesitant to try this product because I've never used an oil cleanser and I was afraid it would make my skin too oily. This product did not! I actually liked the smooth oil texture of the cleanser and I felt like it did a good job of cleaning my face. It is a little messy if mixing with makeup but I just clean the residue as I go.

I've used balm cleansers and makeup wipe removers in the past to remove my makeup, so I was on the market to use an oil cleanser. I wear a full beat of makeup, so I loved how easily and quickly the oil cleanser broke everything down before I went in with another cleanser. It removes waterproof mascara and eyeliner without smearing it all over my face. I love how gentle it is as I already have sensitive skin! Will continue using and repurchasing!!

avis.titre: Melts makeup instantly without irritating my skin!
avis.texte: This cleansing oil is such a game changer. I use it as my first step at night and it removes everything so smoothly, from long wear foundation to stubborn mascara, without any tugging. It feels silky, rinses clean, and doesn't leave a greasy film at all. My sensitive skin stays calm and hydrated instead of tight or red. I also love that it doesn't have a strong scent. It makes my nighttime routine feel quick and luxurious at the same time. Definitely a product I'll keep repurchasing!
I did use this as a double cleanse. Worked well for makeup removal and good texture. Not sure if I'd use for single cleanse.

I have been struggling to find a product that I feel adequately clean to my skin without stripping it bare. This product effectively removes my make up well also leaving my skin leaving soft and smooth.

avis.titre: I WOULD BUY THIS PRODUCT A MILLION TIMES OVER
avis.texte: I am obsessed with how well this cleansing oil works, and i love that i can travel with it easily! I feel so much more moisturized and clean after washing my face now, and will definitely recommend this to anyone who wears makeup often!

avis.titre: First time trying Bioderma cleansing oil
avis.texte: First time trying Bioderma cleansing oil And I'm in love with it. It is perfect for deep cleansing especially removing blackheads skin exfoliate skin. Definitely will purchase it
I love this cleansing oil in combination with my regular skincare routine gets rid of stubborn eye makeup really well.
This is a great lightweight cleansing oil to clean ur face it instantly removes ur makeup facial products within a few scrubs I can see it melting off my face

Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Face Cleansing Oil is a great addition to my end of the day routine. It does a great job of cutting through the make up on my face. It pairs nicely with the cleanser I already have at home. A small pump is all that is needed to cover your face. As a note, I have normal skin and get a few breakouts here and there. Great product for the price point.
Quickly melts tough makeup off and cleans and balances dry to normal skin. Follow up with your normal cleanser after and your skin is left smooth and moisturized.

avis.titre: Great for dry and oily skin
avis.texte: I recently started using the Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil, and I'm seriously impressed with how well it works on my sensitive skin. It breaks down makeup and sunscreen in seconds and rinses off easily, leaving my skin smooth and comfortable. I love that it doesn't sting or leave any residue, just a soft, hydrated feeling. It's become a must-have in my nighttime skincare routine.

The Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil is a great addition to my skincare routine! It melts away makeup and sunscreen effortlessly, leaving my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and calm — perfect for sensitive skin. I love that it rinses off easily and doesn't leave a greasy film behind. The only small downside is that it feels a bit weird if it gets into your eyes, so I just make sure to keep them closed while cleansing. Overall, it's gentle, effective, and makes my skin feel super clean and comfortable!

Having this SENSIBIO MICELLAR CLEANSING OIL as a sample for review. It would be great if they had a smaller size for travel so I don't have to pour it into another travel container. The way the package is sealed prevents spills. But I find it difficult to open the seal for the first time, especially with my long nails. This Micellar Cleansing Oil's texture is not heavy on my skin. Another plus is that it doesn't have a strong scent at all. This product is not very special to me, so I wouldn't consider buying it compared to cheaper Micellar Cleansing Oil for sensitive skin. My skincare and makeup weren't completely removed on my first try. It works okay. Doesn't cause any dryness, discomfort, redness, or irritation.

Removes all of my makeup including waterproof mascara proof. Gentle on my skin and non irritating. Leaves my face feeling hydrated and nourished (I have dryer sensitive skin) Would definitely recommend to anyone!

I absolutely love this cleansing oil! It does a fantastic job at effortlessly removing my makeup, even my waterproof mascara. I am sometimes wary of cleansing oils, as they can cause me eye irritation, or leave an oily residue after washing off. However, this product is so great because it doesn't cause either of these issues. This is a very effective product!

avis.titre: One of the best cleansing oils
avis.texte: I'm genuinely impressed with this Cleansing Oil! It melts away makeup and sunscreen effortlessly, even stubborn mascara and long-wear foundation just glide off. it leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and never greasy or stripped. It's super gentle, so it's perfect for my sensitive skin, and it doesn't cause any redness or irritation. this oil is perfect for double cleansing because it doesn't leave any oily residue behind.

avis.titre: Clean, gentle, and perfect for a flawless double cleanse
avis.texte: The Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil works really well in the shower for removing makeup and sunscreen without irritating the skin. It emulsifies into a milky texture when water is added, making it easy to rinse off and leave the skin feeling clean but not dry. It's gentle, effective, and perfect for a double cleanse routine.
This is a review for the Bioderma Sensibo Micellar Oil. I did not like this cleansing oil. It made me breakout.

avis.titre: Gentle, effective, and perfect for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This cleansing oil is amazing for removing makeup, even stubborn mascara, without irritating my sensitive skin. It feels light, non-greasy, and leaves my skin soft and hydrated after rinsing. I also love that it doesn't have a strong scent and doesn't cause any redness or bumps. Definitely a must-have for anyone with sensitive or reactive skin!

This cleansing oil is a game-changer for sensitive skin. It melts away makeup, sunscreen, and buildup effortlessly while keeping skin soft and balanced. The texture feels silky but not heavy, and it rinses off clean without leaving any residue or causing breakouts. It's fragrance-free, gentle on the eyes, and perfect for anyone who wants a soothing yet effective first cleanse. My skin feels nourished and calm every time I use it.

I have very sensitive skin that gets red and tight easily, and this cleansing oil has been such a game changer. The texture feels silky and lightweight, and it melts away all my makeup and sunscreen effortlessly — even waterproof mascara — without any irritation or stinging around my eyes. When I add a little water, it turns into a milky texture that rinses off clean without leaving a greasy film. What I love most is how soft and calm my skin feels afterward — no dryness or burning, just hydrated and comfortable. I've noticed my skin barrier looks healthier and less reactive since switching to this. It's also fragrance-free, which is a huge plus for me. The only thing I'd note is that if you have oily or acne-prone skin, you might still want to follow up with a water-based cleanser, but for normal to dry sensitive skin, this is perfect. I'll definitely keep repurchasing — it's gentle, effective, and feels like a mini facial every night.

avis.titre: great to get mascara and eyeliner off
avis.texte: i usually wear waterproof mascaras and eyeliners when i wear makeup and i think this oil cleanser is so effective in loosing all that up to wipe off. I love that it doesnt have fragrances and its super clean. Its also not like super greasy feeling like other makeup cleaners ive used
This cuts down having to go through multiple washes when I'm coming back from a night out or any occasion. It's been a real lifesaver.

After using it for about to weeks I'm not really a fan of this product . It took the makeup off but after a few days my skin started to break out . Hence the rest of the products I used afterwards have been in my routine for years . If I didnt break out id probably like the product more

avis.titre: Takes off my heavy makeup quickly
avis.texte: I love how this product feels thin and is easy to quickly wash the makeup off my face!!

I love this oil cleanser - I've never tried it but love the other products in this line. This one is thinner than others which is great because the thick ones can be hard to use, and it's just as effective. I think I may switch to this.
This oil is great for removing makeup and debris from the face. If found it helps better than my nightly scrub and my skin feels breathable after.

I love how this product removes heavy and waterproof makeup without leaving a residue. It didnt cause irritation or strip the skin's natural moisture. It left my skin feeling moisturized, nourished, and soft.
I loved this product, a Best Buy to winters and the holiday season. It leaves the skin clear and moist after use. Removed my waterproof mascara without any itch in my eyes.
Sensibo Micellar has definitely made a fan out of me. I've never really used cleansing oil before but this makes my skin feel so clean and it gets my makeup off flawlessly!

I received the Sensibo Micellar Cleaning Oil for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been really pleased with how well it melts away makeup and sunscreen without irritating my skin. It feels lightweight, rinses off easily, and leaves my skin soft and clean without that heavy, greasy feeling some oils can have. Overall, it's a great first step in my skincare routine.

For many years I've been using the ELF cleansing balm, and got to try out this cleansing oil. It's like one less step than using a balm. If my skin is particularly congested, I can see the filaments come out of my nose and chin as I push this product into my skin in circular motions. The packaging is cute, and I appreciate the hygienic approach of a pump instead of having to dig in. The scent is faint, which is good because I don't like strong fragrances in skincare products and also believe it causes skin reactions. It's a good product. I would love to have a mini, since I'm a traveler always on the go, and the normal size is quite large to lug around. But good product.
Not the best but not the worst, it left a sticky feeling even after I washed it off, not much but I felt my face extra tacky

avis.titre: Breaks down, make up with ease
avis.texte: I was very amazed how little effort I had to use to remove the waterproof eyeliner for me a little bit go a long way it definitely leaves your skin nice and shiny but for me just a little bit too oily. It is a great product though to tackle those hard to remove waterproof Make up.

Thanks Bioderma for the free cleansing oil! I use this to take off my makeup at the end of the day. It takes off all my makeup without drying me out and leaves skin soft without that greasy feeling. My skin is typically on the drier side & it's worked great for me

avis.titre: Works well to remove makeup and helps with dryness
avis.texte: The cleansing oil works well to remove makeup and has a nice mild scent. While the instructions specify no washing is needed afterwards I have experienced some mild acne if I don't do so. Overall, it works well and helps with hydration for my skin, which tends to be dry.

I enjoy this for days where my eczema prone sensitive skin needs extra moisture; the product is applied on dry skin and water is applied to emulsify the formula. I usually follow up with a second cleanse with a water based formula and my skin does not feel super stripped afterwards. I like that the product is in a pump jar and easy to dispense.

This cleansing oil helps remove stubborn makeup, especially around the lip area when I wear 24 hour lipstick. It's gentle and don't break me out. Best of all, I don't have to double cleanse with this oil. It's perfect for my use case.
I really enjoyed it. It's gonna be a staple on my double cleanse, it melts a makeup even waterproof mascara but it doesn't leave the skin feeling dry either.

I liked this cleansing oil overall, but gave it 4 stars because it has a slight vegetable oil scent. It removes makeup and impurities well and can be rinsed off without double cleansing, though I still prefer to follow with a cleanser since I have oily skin.

I received a sample of this for free in exchange for my honest review. I use it after I wash my face with my regular face wash as an extra cleanser/moisturizer and then use the Micellar Water to rinse. The cleansing oil is very hydrating and leaves my skin glowy! I'd be careful not to use too much as it could make your skin look oily. Overall, I enjoy using this as part of my nighttime skin routine.

avis.titre: I would buy this but its not everything I hoped for
avis.texte: It made my skin super hydrated and supple, but it did leave an awful lot of makeup residue behind

I really wanted to like this cleansing oil, but it just wasn't for me — though to be fair, I don't usually love oily products to begin with. The texture felt heavier than I prefer, and after using it, I felt like I needed to wash my face a couple of times to get that leftover oily layer off. As for removing makeup, it did an okay job with foundation and light products, but I found myself scrubbing quite a bit to get off my regular (not waterproof) mascara, which was disappointing. My skin did feel soft afterward, but not as clean as I like — more like it had a thin film left behind. That said, if you enjoy oil-based cleansers and don't mind a dewy finish, this could still be a good fit for you. It just wasn't the best match for my personal preferences or cleansing routine.

avis.titre: Great on sensitive skin and if you have rosacea
avis.texte: I have combination sensitive skin with rosacea. With the colder weather, my skin is now pretty dry. My derm suggested using this instead of washing my face in the morning which was flaring up my rosacea. I've been using it for about a week and I love it. It makes my face feel soft and luxurious. It hasn't flared up my rosaca and I haven't broken out. My skin feels a lot calmer and even though I'm patting it dry off my face, it feels like my skin has a barrier on it to protect it throughout the day.

Nice oil cleanser! I like that it breaks down all of my makeup and sunscreen and then emulsifies with a little water and melts everything away. I use their micellar water on my sensitive eyes so not sure how it fairs with mascara, but it's great for the face.

I loved this for removing waterproof mascara as I always struggle to remove my mascara with regular micellar water. Though even though I loved it the cleansing oil clogged my pores up a little bit. But I still recommend.
This cleansing oil is great! It has a very nice feel on the face. This cleansing oil removed my makeup with ease. This product did not irritate my skin or break me out which is rare

This is amazing at cutting through a day of grime and makeup and pulling all the gunk to the surface. Really easy to work in, doesn't smell or leave a film. It lathers well when water is added and leaves my skin prepped for my next steps. You don't have to double cleanse, but I do out of habit.

avis.titre: Melts Makeup Away Like a Dream!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try the Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil, and it did not disappoint! As a first step in my double-cleanse routine, it's perfect. The oil has a lovely, silky texture that glides over the skin, effortlessly dissolving makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime. It even tackles waterproof eye makeup without any stinging or irritation. When you add water, it emulsifies beautifully and rinses away completely clean, leaving no greasy residue behind. My skin feels incredibly soft, nourished, and perfectly prepped for my second cleanser. A fantastic choice for all skin types, even sensitive ones!

I received a free sample of the Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil. It took off my makeup and didn't leave my skin feeling oily at all. I usually use a cleanser over an oil, however, I would recommend this to others who are looking for an oil.

avis.titre: Wish it was not so oily
avis.texte: While it worked efficiently at getting of my eye make up quickly, this product is extremely oily. It felt like it almost left a residue where my vision was blurred slightly for a few minutes after using on my lids/lashes. Also, it has a strong smell of vegetable oil.

I did not know that this brand also had an oil with it. Sometimes with oils, I tend to break out, and this did not occur. The oil is nice and light and hydrating without being heavy. I felt like it gave me a great glow afterwards.

This oil cleanser is AMAZING! It melts off all of my makeup and emulsifies to nice, foamy soap after I wet my face to wash it off. Although the bottle appears to be small, I only need half a pump for my whole face. I'm able to spread it around evenly and it feels very nice on my skin.

Overall, Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil seems like a strong option if you want something that's effective at makeup/sunscreen removal and gentle for sensitive skin, without feeling overly harsh or stripping. If I were you, I'd consider using it especially in the evening as the first cleanse, especially on days when you wear more makeup or sunscreen; and on lighter days maybe a gentler or simpler cleanser might suffice.

avis.titre: This cleansing oil leaves your pores empty!
avis.texte: This product leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped. I have dry skin and this worked very well for me. Great for taking off makeup too!

avis.titre: Oil based cleanser - two thumbs up
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for writing the review. The oil cleanser is very light weight but concentrated. It doesn't have a smell and made my skin feel hydrated and soft. I'm curious how my skin will feel tomorrow morning. I love the oil based cleanser!

This micellar cleansing oil did not irritate my skin, and the pump made it convenient to use. It was necessary to lather it up for makeup removal. It did not remove all of my makeup as effortlessly as I had hoped, including eye makeup. I had to use a second cleanser to remove all traces of makeup, and it seemed to take more rubbing on my face than I expected. I have combination skin, but this felt a bit too oily for my skin. I will continue to use it to help remove my eye makeup, but I would probably not repurchase when I run out. This cleansing oil was gifted to me in exchange for my honest review..

avis.titre: "No Double Cleanse Needed with This Cleansing Oil
avis.texte: I was initially hesitant to try this cleansing oil because I have oily/combination skin, but I'm so glad I did — it's amazing. It makes my skin feel soft and nourished after cleansing, and it removes even waterproof mascara with ease. It doesn't sting or irritate my eyes and leaves no greasy residue behind, so there's no need to double cleanse. This product has completely changed how I think about oil cleansers!

avis.titre: I'm such a big fan of the brand!
avis.texte: I got this cleansing oil and was super excited to try it out, especially for removing waterproof makeup. I actually really liked it! The only thing is that around the eyes it takes a bit more effort to fully remove everything, and I have to be careful when using it on my lashes. Other than that, it worked great — it didn't irritate my skin and left it feeling super clean. ✨

From the first use, it felt luxuriously smooth and removed every trace of makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime without any stinging or tightness. It melts away even stubborn mascara but still rinses off cleanly, leaving my skin soft, calm, and hydrated. It does not leave me feeling greasy. What makes this product special is its micellar-infused oil formula, which gives the deep-clean feel of a cleansing oil with the gentleness Sensibio is known for. My skin barrier feels happier, and redness has noticeably decreased after a few weeks of use. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it sometimes takes two rinses to remove heavier foundation. Still, those are small trade-offs for a cleanser that's this gentle and effective.

I received this product free in exchange for an honest review. I wasn't sure what to expect because I've never used a cleansing oil before, but this stuff is great. It gets even waterproof mascara off like a breeze and my skin feels amazing.

Thanks Bioderma for the free Micellar Cleansing Oil! This left my face feeling clean and smooth. I'm always afraid of breakouts using a new product but this was great! I didn't feel oily after using it. I like that there was no scent! I would recommend this product and I would buy it again!

I've been using this oil for a few weeks now and I can confidently say this is the best cleanser I've used. Doesn't leave a film on my face. Actually feels hydrating and clean at the same time. Will definitely repurchase in the future!

The texture is silky and lightweigh which melts makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime. Even waterproof mascara comes off easily. What I love most is how gentle it feels. My skin is quite sensitive and often reacts to oils, but this one doesn't cause redness, stinging, or breakouts. It rinses off cleanly without leaving a greasy film, and my face actually feels soft and hydrated afterward instead of stripped or tight. There's also no heavy fragrance, which is a big plus if you're sensitive to scents. I usually use it as the first step in my evening double-cleanse routine, and it pairs perfectly with a mild foaming cleanser afterward. Overall, this cleansing oil is soothing, effective, and truly suitable for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: First Oil Makeup Cleanser I tried
avis.texte: I used this oil cleanser for a few weeks after I received my free sample in order to write a honest review. I found that my skin felt well hydrated after using, and the makeup had flawlessly come off without the need to rub extensively. I typically use this product at night because it is super hydrating. I've noticed skin improvement, especially with the dryness around my eyes. I work in dermatology so I have convinced coworkers to also try this makeup cleansing product, especially for the colder months when skin typically gets drier. So far, many like this product as well!!
Doesn't irritate sensitive skin and removes heavy thick makeup without stripping skin or feeling too greasy
A little pump goes a long way. This oil cleanser was no to oily for my skin and didn't cause breakouts. It did a great job of removing my makeup.
This product works great if you are looking for a cleansing oil. I typically prefer a foaming cleanser but this was a great alternative. Does a great job cleaning makeup off.
This cleansing oil was great! I used it on my nose because i have a lot of pores there and after a few uses i noticed a difference. I have not broken out and it does not affect my sensitive skin.
I have been wanting an oil cleanser for a while and I am so glad I have gotten this one. It makes my skin feel still hydrated after using this product without making it feel oily.

I recently added Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil to my skincare routine, and I'm genuinely impressed. As someone with sensitive skin, I'm always cautious about introducing new products, but this one has been incredibly gentle and effective.

avis.titre: Perfect for sebaceous filaments and hard to remove mascara
avis.texte: I love this cleanser to take care of sebaceuous filaments. My nose pores often get clogged as the weather changes - shout out dry skin girlies. It also is great for removing stubborn mascara. I recommend following up with a good hydrating cleanser for the best result.

The Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil is a good product for anyone with sensitive skin that needs a gentle, yet effective cleanse. The cleansing oil melts away makeup and sunscreen without any stinging or irritation. The formula is lightweight and non-greasy, making it perfect for daily use. My skin always feels clean,soft, and refreshed. Definitely worth checking out. I received this product for free in exchange for review.
I love this cleansing oil. The best I've ever tried. When used correctly you could glow and earn beautiful skin!

avis.titre: Love how soft it made my skin feel
avis.texte: Great product. Cleaned off even my most stubborn make up. Was not har.. kept my skin hydrated
I loved it for my nightly facial cleansing, especially for removing makeup. It provides hydration to my skin.

Love this one for my double cleanse routine. It melts off the waterproof mascara I use and and rinses clean without leaing my skin feeling overly greasy. My skin feels soft after use and it's fragrance-free, which I really appreciate for sensitive skin.

I like this cleansing oil. It really does get rid of makeup. I would be cautious using it around the eyes. Could be user error, but I didn't care for the feeling I got after I took off my mascara. It rinsed right off, though. My face felt clean after using this oil.

I use this when I wear a full beat of makeup, sealed with a hairspray ---like setting spray. This oil melts all my makeup while not stripping my skin. No sticky residue left and smells nice. Good size for daily use though I only use when wearing sunscreen or full makeup.

This is a great cleansing oil that leaves my skin feeling moisturized and soft. A little goes a long way so the bottle will last a while. It is very gentle and doesn't irritate my skin or dry it out. Great at removing eye products (eye shadow, mascara, eyeliner) which has a tendency to stick to my skin.
I've never tried a cleansing oil makeup remover but have always wanted to! This didn't disappoint

avis.titre: Left my skin feeling so soft
avis.texte: I used this product to gently remove the sunblock residue from my skin. The product overall has a nice scent. My skin did not experience any inflammation, but instead retain its moisture from the product. Be sure to apply the product in small circular motion on your hand first before applying it to your face. With a product of such great quality, this needs to be packaged in a much more durable bottle.

avis.titre: I'm in love with the quality of this cleansing oil
avis.texte: I recently received a free sample of the Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil from Bioderma through the BzzAgent sampling program, and I was pleasantly surprised by the amazing quality! It easily outperforms my high end oil cleanser and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed without any dryness or tightness. I also appreciate how thick and concentrated it is and a little truly goes a long way. My only small complaint is that the pump can be a bit strong and sometimes squirts product too far, but overall, it's a fantastic cleanser and I'd definitely recommend.

At first I didn't think I liked this product, but, once again, I've come to find reading is fundamental. Applied to a dry face it will melt all your makeup off. Applied to a wet facd it doesn't do much. Removed well, and didn't leave a weird film. No clogged pores are sensitivity problems. I like this product!
I liked the moisturizing benefits from this cleansing oil. My skin is very sensitive and naturally dry and loved this product!

avis.titre: My skin is happier! Less breakouts!
avis.texte: I have been using this product as a double-cleanser in the evenings. I start with the Sensibio Cleansing Oil and then follow up with a gentle foaming cleanser. My skin is clearer and I am noticing less breakouts. The cleansing oil really gets my skin clean! It does not leave any residue when I follow up with a gentle cleanser as well which I appreciate. It is gentle on my sensitive skin and removes makeup with ease (even waterproof)! I also appreciate how it is fragrance free.
Sensibio cleansing oil melts away makeup and sunscreen effortlessly, even waterproof products, without stinging my eyes or leaving a greasy film. My skin feels soft, calm, and hydrated after rinsing.

I'm a huge fan of double cleansing with an oil based cleanser followed by a regular foam cleanser. I have been doing it for years! I usually stick to one product I like, and don't replace because that's what works for me. But OMG this cleansing oil replaced my go to cleansing oil, that's how much I liked it. It was much lighter weight, easier to clean, got all the sunscreen/everyday makeup out. I followed it with a regular cleanser and my skin has been looking amazing recently. Highly recommend this one!! I will be purchasing it as soon as I finish this bottle.

avis.titre: Does the job, but leaves a greasy feel
avis.texte: I've tried Korean cleansing oils before, and this one leaves a bit of greasiness on the skin. It removes makeup but not as effectively as others, and it has a higher usage per wash. Since you still need a foam cleanser afterward, it's fine overall — I'd only recommend it if no other option is available. I got the product for free in exchange for writing the review.
Great cleansing oil! It removes all my hard to take off makeup with mascara and eyeliner, my foundation immediately comes off. It's not drying either.
I really enjoyed this makeup remover. I have dry skin so it worked great for me, not sure how oilier skins would do. It takes off any waterproof makeup so seamlessly. Would definitely recommend.

This micellar cleansing oil works great as the first step in a double cleanse. It breaks down makeup and sunscreen easily, and I love how it just dissolves when water is added. No greasy residue, just clean, soft skin.

avis.titre: really nice for dry eczema skin
avis.texte: I have dry eczema skin. what I like about this is that it's actually quite thick like a real oil. im not sure if you have oily skin, that you would like this kind of texture. But it removed everything of course and it did not irritate my eyes removing mascara. I actually only used this and my face was well cleansed enough that I could just move on to toner and moisturizer and not have to double cleanse if you're lazy like me :P
I like this product because it leaves my skin feeling nourished and moisturized. I use it on my eye makeup and it removes mascara without irritation. I would buy this again

avis.titre: I love this for removing makeup
avis.texte: This product is great for removing my makeup at the end of the day. It just melts right off. Keeps my skin clear and ready for a new day.
